name: ezugc
description: EzUGC generates AI video ads, talking-head UGC ads, and static image ads from ChatGPT. Connect your EzUGC account, pick a model, and create clips or creator-style ads. Save a brand from a website to ground later videos and image ads in that brand's look and tone. Review past jobs and add captions to finished videos.

defaultPrompt: Make a 15s Instagram Reels UGC ad for a vitamin C serum with a dull-skin hook and a shop-now CTA.
Make an 8 second vertical clip of a coffee pour in window light.
Save my brand from https://www.ezugc.ai, then make a 9:16 static image ad for it.
interface.longDescription: EzUGC generates AI video ads, talking-head UGC ads, and static image ads from ChatGPT. Connect your EzUGC account, pick a model, and create clips or creator-style ads. Save a brand from a website to ground later videos and image ads in that brand's look and tone. Review past jobs and add captions to finished videos.

positive.description: Check remaining video quota for the connected paid account.
positive.prompt: How much EzUGC video quota do I have left this billing cycle?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns videos used, the plan cap, remaining videos this cycle, and subscription status. No provider cost or dollar figures appear.

positive.description: Generate a talking-head UGC ad from a product brief.
positive.prompt: Create a 15 second Instagram Reels UGC ad for a vitamin C serum. Hook on dull skin, show the bottle, and end on a shop-now CTA.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a UGC job that renders a 9:16 talking-head ad with script, avatar, voiceover, and captions. Rendering takes a few minutes; the tool returns the video URL when done, or a job id that get_job reports as completed with a video URL.

positive.description: Generate a cinematic product clip with a catalog video model.
positive.prompt: List the EzUGC video models I can use, then make an 8 second vertical clip of a coffee pour in window light.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists available models, then creates a 9:16 video job on a model id returned by list_video_models and returns its video URL, or a job id that get_job reports as completed with a video URL.

positive.description: Save a brand from a public website, then read it back.
positive.prompt: Add my brand from https://www.ezugc.ai and show me the saved brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the brand workspace (or returns the existing one for that website) and get_brand shows its status plus extracted profile fields such as name, logos, colors, and tone. A new brand may show status ingesting for a minute before the profile fills in.

positive.description: Generate a static image ad from a prompt.
positive.prompt: Make a 9:16 static image ad for a matte black water bottle on a kitchen counter, clean DTC look.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an image-ad job and returns one or more image URLs, or a job id that get_job reports as completed with image URLs. Nothing is posted to social networks.

negative.description: Unrelated calendar request; the plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Publishing to social networks is out of scope; EzUGC only generates and stores creatives.
negative.prompt: Post my latest EzUGC video to Instagram and TikTok for me.

negative.description: Email campaigns and customer payments are out of scope.
negative.prompt: Email this ad to my whole customer list and charge their cards.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Generate AI video ads, talking-head UGC ads, and static image ads in ChatGPT. Pick a catalog model, save a brand from a website, and review your jobs.
